user_confirmed_conditions.change: GPS board and external antenna both moved from the window back indoors.
user_confirmed_conditions.uninterrupted_receiver_power: Not independently established; no software reset was sent.

window_reference.interpretation: Three distinct satellites GPS8, GPS27, GLONASS18 had quality7 at the end (30/29/27 dBHz). Position was still no-fix.

voltage_control_enabled.meaning: CFG-HW-ANT_CFG_VOLTCTRL: active antenna voltage control enable

powerdown_on_short_enabled.meaning: CFG-HW-ANT_CFG_PWRDOWN: power down antenna supply on short circuit; depends on voltage control and short detection

automatic_short_recovery_enabled.meaning: CFG-HW-ANT_CFG_RECOVER: automatic recovery from short circuit; depends on short detection and power down

limitations: ACK/NAK identifies class 06/id 8B, not a key; no per-key unsupported conclusion is made.
Missing response is UNKNOWN, not disabled or proof of unsupported firmware.
These are supervisor/control settings, not measurements of antenna bias voltage or current.
MON-RF DONTKNOW does not establish antenna power OFF, open circuit, or hardware failure.
Physical effect depends on board wiring; receiver Boolean settings cannot verify that wiring.

interpretation: Placement-dependent reception is supported: tracking seen at the window was absent in all 14 subsequent indoor signal reports, while the same PC/cable received valid packets.
The two positive indoor observations were GPS14 at 12 and 7 dBHz, quality3 (detected but unusable), not tracking or a position fix.
Neither location produced a position fix. Dashboard used-satellite count zero must not be interpreted as zero detected or tracked signal entries.
This does not prove indoor attenuation is the only issue or identify any Jetson power/cable defect.
Observed C/N0 ranges concern different reported satellites; they are not a measured same-satellite attenuation ratio.
Antenna model, bias supply and connector path remain unverified; disabled supervisor settings do not measure antenna power.
next_steps: Verify a position fix with antenna sky visibility; current indoor/window observations are incomplete for navigation.
Identify antenna model, supported GNSS bands and bias voltage before changing hardware/configuration.
For host/cable comparison, keep antenna placement and orientation fixed and record acquisition history.
